w.en: and that which is strangled (to death)
and that which is hit fatally
and that which has a fatal fall
w.bn: ও উপর থেকে পড়ে মৃত জন্তু

w.en: and that which is gored by horns
ones who train animals to hunt
and I will surely admit you
and surely We (would have) admitted them
w.bn: এবং অবশ্যই আমরা প্রবেশ করাতাম তাদের

w.en: He will call you to account

w.bn: ও কোরবানির জন্যে কাবায় পাঠানো জন্তু

w.en: you have spoken the truth to us
